name: Claire Branch
source:
A young woman who owns a bar in the airport city Nemo. She is actually a Class-B Reyvateil. Claire works at the bar by singing healing songs with her Reyvateil powers.

She has many fans in Nemo, and she gets new customers everyday. Claire believes that songs should be sung for the common people, and would never sing songs that harm others. She wants her songs to touch the hearts of people.

She is like a big sister that strictly, yet kindly, guides [url=/c3681]Lyner[/url] and the girls into doing the right thing.

[Edited from [url=http://nisamerica.com/games/artonelico/]Ar Tonelico Official Site[/url]]
